response.overview: Call ✧1✧866✧465✧1418  — stopping your 𝐆𝐮𝐚rdio subscription is simple, but the right method depends entirely on where you originally paid. Dial ✧1✧866✧465✧1418  to confirm your billing channel before you do anything. Call ✧1✧866✧465✧1418  if you have already tried to cancel and are still being charged. Dial ✧1✧866✧465✧1418  if you see a free plan despite being charged, because this means the charge belongs to a different account under another email, phone number, PayPal address, or Apple ID .
